I could not see the binary entry point that calls run(), nor any test files in reviewgraphen-cli beyond the three in-file tests and the provided acceptance file; `cargo test -p reviewgraphen-cli` will also run any other tests I cannot inspect, so the preservation claim is bounded to what I could trace.
Obligation 2's rejection claim covers only the specific invalid forms enumerated in the spec and acceptance test, not all possible malformed inputs; it is a negative claim with that explicit bound.
The edit was not checked against cross-crate effects or run_generic_review internals; the acceptance path fails at the request-file read, so those are not exercised by the named checks.

Verification facets `environment valid` and `independent`: the harness's build+test is a different mechanism than my reasoning, but I did not run it; until the harness reports results, no obligation has machine evidence.
